applies_to: exact ledger reconstruction in sell-buy notation
excludes: non-replay TRADEX research unless separately adopted

ownership: Current State / Problem / Change Policy / Concrete Instructions synthesis
repo inspection under the frozen contract

only_when: the work is limited to very small documentation edits
the work is limited to very small registry or pointer edits
the frozen 3-step workflow is preserved explicitly

fixed_authority_rules: Only GPT-5.4 Thinking defines scope and non-scope.
Only GPT-5.4 Thinking defines confirmed vs provisional vs research-fallback status.
Only GPT-5.4 Thinking freezes comparison conditions.
Only GPT-5.4 Thinking decides success or failure against the frozen contract.
Only GPT-5.4 Thinking issues keep / drop / hold judgment.
delegable_work: implementing replay and ledger code under a frozen contract
wiring replay inputs and outputs under a frozen contract
generating JSON, parquet, and supporting replay artifacts
small scoped refactors under a frozen contract
forbidden_executor_actions: silently skipping delegation when Step 2 includes meaningful implementation, artifact generation, or verification work
acceptance_criteria: Replay research role ownership is explicit and machine-readable.
Step 2 delegation to a separate GPT-5.4 mini high sub-agent is the default path for meaningful execution work.
Trivial inline Step 2 exceptions are narrow and explicit.
Unavailable delegation is marked as research-fallback.
The policy cannot be mistaken for a MeeMee or TRADEX product-behavior change.
non_scope: TRADEX artifact schemas outside this workflow-policy contract

boundary_check.statement: This contract governs replay-research workflow discipline only. It does not move research logic into MeeMee or move MeeMee display/operational concerns into TRADEX research execution.
